title: The Monk Who Almost Got Rejected From The Speech That Made Him Famous
description: The wild true story of how a wandering monk almost missed the 1893 Chicago speech that made him a global icon, until a Harvard professor's snap decision changed everything. AI-narrated commentary on real, independently documented history.
